method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Timer 响起，Hattie 起身从烤箱取出烤好的面包
facts.anchor: The timer dings and she rises to take the bread from the oven.

facts.fact: 她那部本以为不可能再响的旧手机开始 ringing
facts.anchor: Her old phone starts to ring.

facts.fact: 她把抽屉完全拉开并取出手机，手机在手里震动
facts.anchor: She finds herself pulling the drawer the rest of the way open and drawing the phone out.

facts.fact: 梦中 Tommy 用空洞的声音说“对不起，妈妈”，喊她帮忙停下
facts.anchor: “I’m sorry, Momma,” Tommy says in a hollow croak.

facts.fact: Hattie 猛地惊醒，发现自己躺在床上、只是做梦
她打开床头柜抽屉，里面空无一物，但去年十二月的记忆翻涌
facts.anchor: Nothing. Empty. But memories still churn from last December.

facts.fact: 她让记忆涌入，像过去十个月一样重温那一夜
facts.anchor: She does. It hurts, but she relives the night as she has for the past ten months.

facts.fact: Hattie 起床开始准备，心里想着今天有很多事要做
facts.anchor: Hattie climbs from bed and starts to get ready.
